The Muennink Advantage
At Muennink Grain we take great pride in our three generations of experience in the business and we strive each and every day to prove ourselves to both our new and existing customers. It is our promise to you that we will only offer quality grain, chemical and supply products with unrivaled service to back up those products.
Try us out, we are certain that you will be happy with everything we offer and the level of service we give to every customer.
Brands You Know & Trust
Just like the brand name products you buy at the grocery store, you want to buy feed, grain and chemical supplies from companies that you have heard of. That is why we carry a wide range of products from Nutrena, Cargill, SunOpta and Croplan Genetics; all quality brands with well established track records in our industry. Along with these well established brands we believe there are great buys from smaller companies that you may not have heard of, and that is why we are always looking for new quality products that are also a great value.
